prepared:
printf '%s' "$TOKEN" | docker login ghcr.io --username "$ACTOR" --password-stdin
printf '%s' "$TOKEN" | helm registry login ghcr.io --username "$ACTOR" --password-stdin

curl -fsSLO https://github.com/indygreg/apple-platform-rs/releases/download/apple-codesign%2F0.29.0/apple-codesign-0.29.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
echo "dbe85cedd8ee4217b64e9a0e4c2aef92ab8bcaaa41f20bde99781ff02e600002  apple-codesign-0.29.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
tar xzf apple-codesign-0.29.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
sudo install -m 0755 apple-codesign-0.29.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/rcodesign /usr/local/bin/rcodesign

curl -fsSL https://releases.plumb.perish.uk/manage.sh -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/manage-plumb.sh"
env PLUMB_CHANNEL=stable PLUMB_VERSION= sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/manage-plumb.sh" install
echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

for product in plumb ectropy; do
  curl -fsSL "https://releases.$product.perish.uk/manage.sh" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/manage-$product.sh"
  env PLUMB_CHANNEL=stable PLUMB_VERSION= ECTROPY_CHANNEL=stable ECTROPY_VERSION= sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/manage-$product.sh" install
done
echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

rustup toolchain install "$RUST" --profile minimal --component clippy --component rustfmt
rustup default "$RUST"

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
if ($env:PNPM -notmatch '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$') { throw 'pnpm needs the exact domain version' }
$name = 'pnpm-win32-x64.zip'
$url = "https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/releases/download/v$env:PNPM/$name"
$release = Invoke-RestMethod "https://api.github.com/repos/pnpm/pnpm/releases/tags/v$env:PNPM" -TimeoutSec 30
$assets = @($release.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -ceq $name })
if ($assets.Count -ne 1) { throw 'declared native pnpm asset is missing or ambiguous' }
$asset = $assets[0]
if ($asset.browser_download_url -cne $url -or $asset.digest -cnotmatch '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' -or $asset.size -gt 134217728) { throw 'native pnpm asset identity is not admitted' }
$root = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ('wharf-pnpm-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
if (Test-Path $root) { throw 'native pnpm destination already exists' }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $root | Out-Null
$archive = Join-Path $root $name
Invoke-WebRequest $url -OutFile $archive -TimeoutSec 120
$digest = (Get-FileHash $archive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
if ((Get-Item $archive).Length -ne $asset.size -or ('sha256:' + $digest) -cne $asset.digest) { throw 'native pnpm archive differs from canonical digest' }
$directory = Join-Path $root 'tool'
Expand-Archive $archive -DestinationPath $directory
$program = Join-Path $directory 'pnpm.exe'
$actual = & $program --version
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $actual -cne $env:PNPM) { throw 'native pnpm differs from the domain version' }
@{ schema = 1; version = $env:PNPM; digest = $digest; directory = $directory } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress | Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'wharf-pnpm.json')
Write-Output "pnpm version=$actual asset=$url sha256=$digest executable=$program"
$directory | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append

sudo apt-get update -o Acquire::Retries=0 -o Acquire::http::Timeout=30 -o Acquire::https::Timeout=30
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openssh-server
